# Water Capital Wire

> A free daily read on the business of water for managers, investors and operators: capital, companies, technology, infrastructure and water security, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a lead story traced through the water cycle (source, treatment, use, reuse, discharge), briefs across the water economy, weekly spotlights on a company, a leader, a supplier, an innovation and an investor, a capital desk of deals and firms, a water atlas on stress, demand, infrastructure, emerging sectors and security, a watchlist of water equities, a project calculator and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [Enverus says about 90% of AI's water footprint is consumed at the power plant, not the data center](https://watercapitalwire.com/): November 25, 2026. Enverus estimates about 90% of the water tied to AI inference is consumed at the power plant, not the data center. It puts $25 a month of frontier AI use at about 1.9 gallons, power generation included.
- [Utilities: Illinois regulators grant American Water's Illinois unit $74 million, 41% less than it asked](https://watercapitalwire.com/#money)
- [Security: Fiji declares a nationwide state of disaster as El Niño drought reaches crisis level](https://watercapitalwire.com/#world)
- [Regulation: Final EPA PFAS test round lifts the count of Americans with PFAS in tap water to about 197 million](https://watercapitalwire.com/#pfas)
- [Utilities: Lake Powell rises more than 20 feet after record fall rain, but basin talks remain stalled](https://watercapitalwire.com/#powell)
- [Desalination: Saudi Water Authority cancels Wabag's $272 million Yanbu desalination award for a second time](https://watercapitalwire.com/#yanbu)
